# Copilot Instructions for Sri Ayurveda

Use these project-wide rules for all Copilot-assisted work on this repository.

- Prefer focused, minimal edits over broad rewrites.
- Keep the Ayurvedic brand warm, trustworthy, and premium-looking.
- Improve readability with strong text contrast and clean spacing.
- Preserve the existing page structure and routing conventions.
- Keep frontend changes consistent across pages and shared styles.
- Validate React/Vite changes with npm run build when code changes are made.
- Do not claim compliance or medical certainty beyond approved wording.
- Keep content professional, patient-friendly, and respectful.
- Avoid introducing broken imports, invalid routes, or inaccessible color contrast.
- Prefer small, correct changes that maintain existing design intent.
